styles.container:
max-width: 740px; margin: 0 auto; padding: 20px; font-family: 
    "Helvetica Neue", "YuGothic", "Hiragino Kaku Gothic ProN", sans-serif; font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8 !important; color: #3f3f3f !important; background-color: #ffffff; word-wrap: break-word;
styles.ol: margin: 16px 0px 24px; padding: 8px 56px; font-family: 'Noto Serif JP', serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400; line-height: 28px; color: rgb(90, 74, 63);
styles.ol > li: position: relative; counter-increment: item; list-style: none; margin-bottom: 15px;
